title: Harvard Astrophysicist Challenges Ex-Pentagon UFO Investigator's Claims Of Recovered Alien Spacecrafts And Non-Human Bodies

content:
A former Pentagon UFO investigator claims the U.S. has recovered alien spacecraft and non-human bodies (i.e. alien bodies). Harvard astrophysicist Avi Loeb is skeptical of those claims and demands evidence.

This is a curious development because, over the years, Avi Loeb, the head of Harvard’s Galileo Project, which searches for signs of extraterrestrial life, and former chairman of the university’s Department of Astronomy, has made numerous bizarre claims of his own about UFOs and aliens.

Former Pentagon UFO investigator’s claims have been made by other officials

Jay Stratton, the former Chief of Air and Space Warfare for the Defense Intelligence Agency and the first director of the Pentagon’s Unidentified Aerial Phenomena Task Force, recently claimed aliens were recovered alive from the infamous Roswell, New Mexico, crash in 1947, but later died after refusing food and human contact.

Stratton said military contractors possess at least a dozen crashed spacecraft and have recovered non-human remains. In his new memoir, Out of the Shadows, he claims that encounters with non-human intelligence and their technology caused some of those involved “to resign, suffer mental breakdowns, and in some cases take their own lives. The truth was just too difficult for them to process.”

His claim echoes that of other former government officials, including the director of the Pentagon’s Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP) Luis “Lue” Elizondo and David Grusch, an Air Force veteran and former official with the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) and the National Reconnaissance Office (NRO).

Dr. Eric Davis, an astrophysicist who worked with the Pentagon’s UFO program for years, has also asserted that he has personally seen classified images and documents from the U.S. government that purportedly attest to alien life having been discovered in crashed UFOs.

Also, Dr. Hal Puthoff, a former CIA-funded researcher and advisor to the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program, also claimed that the United States has recovered “four separate types” of alien species from crashed UFOs.

Avi Loeb casts doubt on Jay Stratton’s claims

Avi Loeb, who was recently appointed to lead a new Science Advisory Council to study UFO orbs and other military sightings by the White House, claims if there was evidence of the U.S. recovering alien spacecraft and non-human bodies, it would have been shown to President Donald Trump.

“This board [the UAP Science Advisory Council], with comprehensive representation across the executive branch, military and intelligence community, vigorously follows the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters (PURSUE) and would be delighted to review any evidence for technologies of non-human origin,” Loeb wrote on his website.

“Obviously, any groundbreaking revelation about alien intelligence would be of great political benefit to the Trump administration. Why can’t anyone offer President Trump a guided tour to an alien spacecraft or at least some footage of alien bodies?”

Avi Loeb claims Jay Stratton was invited to speak with the Science Advisory Council

“Jay did not respond to my invitation, even after it was repeated by the Council member, Dr. Tim Gallaudet,” Loeb wrote. “Why is it a higher priority for Jay to speak with Bret than with a Council that is dedicated to chasing the evidence and releasing it to the public?”

Loeb also pointed out in a recent interview with Fox 32 News that, although a legal waiver permits employees to exchange confidential UAP data, Stratton has not provided any tangible or digital proof.

For Avi Loeb to cast doubt on Jay Stratton’s claims is interesting considering Loeb has, in the past, strongly suggested that the comet 3I/Atlas might be an alien spacecraft, a 1,300-foot-long asteroid named Oumuamua could also be an alien spaceship, that our universe may have been formed in a lab by an “advanced technological civilization,” that there could be as many as a quadrillion alien spacecrafts traveling in our solar system, and that aliens may have visited Earth using dimension-hopping technology to travel through hidden dimensions.
